column1: # switches.tsv - the switch manifest read by bin/jg-switch.sh.
# Columns (tab separated): change-id, kind, name, want, who (auto|owner), expires (YYYY-MM-DD or -), reason.
# Kinds are listed in the header of bin/jg-switch.sh. A change declares its rows in the same commit as its changes.tsv row.

column7: a machine is enforced only when its name is a line of config/machine-enforce; the owner flips it (jg-machine-guard.sh flip)
no conflict-resolver line: every conflict goes back to the worker; the owner sets the agent command
no retest-runner line: a resolved conflict retests with the default done-done runner; the owner sets the command
